defects_it_found.detail: ResourceNames.stem sanitised the joined developer_worktree_module string and truncated it to 40 characters. On CI the checkout path is long, so the module id was chopped off the end and M00, M04 and M14 all resolved to the SAME Compose project and database. This directly violated 'two simultaneous module profiles have isolated resources'. It passed locally only because this machine's worktree name is short.
defects_it_found.fix: The namespace is now composed from individually-bounded components, so the joined string is never truncated and both discriminators -- the worktree hash and the module id -- always survive. stem() raises rather than returning a name that lost either.
defects_it_found.regression_tests: 15 modules x 5 resource kinds x 5 developer/path shapes asserted distinct; module-id survival, worktree-hash survival, PostgreSQL identifier limits, and an over-budget namespace raising instead of colliding.

defects_it_found.detail: check --suite contracts reported the contract tests as 'not run' on every CI machine, because CI installs from the lockfiles into the runner's Python rather than into .venv. The build failed for the wrong reason.
defects_it_found.fix: test_interpreter() prefers .venv and falls back to the current interpreter when it can import pytest, still returning None (an honest 'not run') when neither can.
